display_name: Spherical Fiber Distribution from Solid-Bound Molecule
summary: **may only be used as the solid (or a component) in a multiphasic mixture (§4.16).** Solid-bound molecule must be defined in `<Globals>` §3.4.3 and included via `<solid_bound>`; `sbm` = global index. ξ = ξ0 (ρσ_r/ρ0)^γ. Not stable on its own (combine via `solid mixture`).
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.4.29 Spherical Fiber Distribution from Solid-Bound Molecule, p235（4.13）
module: multiphasic (must be used as the solid or component of the solid in a multiphasic mixture §4.16)
